operation.label: Space-time scan: Hagelloch 1861 by day of prodrome

source: Measles in Hagelloch, 1861 (Pfeilsticker 1863; Oesterle 1992), as measles_hagelloch_1861 in the R package outbreaks 1.9.0; the copy built into Fieldwork as examples/hagelloch-1861, with this project's georeference

declaredParameters.model: Retrospective space-time permutation (Kulldorff and others, 2005), scanning for high.
declaredParameters.circles: Around each place, places joined in order of distance, places at the same distance together, while the circle holds at most maxCaseShare of all cases. Each distinct set of places once.
declaredParameters.runs: Consecutive days, at most floor(maxTimeShare x days in the study period) long.
declaredParameters.expected: The circle's cases over the period times the run's cases everywhere, over all cases.
declaredParameters.score: c ln(c/e) + (n-c) ln((n-c)/(n-e)) where c > e, else 0.
declaredParameters.secondary: In order of score, each circle's best run, kept only where it shares no place with one kept before.
declaredParameters.pValue: (1 + shuffles whose highest score anywhere is at least this one) / (1 + shuffles); dates shuffled across the fixed cases.

replay.model: Prospective: each day, the scan on the cases with a date up to that day, the study period from the first case, scoring only runs ending that day; at least 4 cases at 2 places over 2 days, or the day is skipped.

integrity.note: SHA-256 of this fixture with the integrity field removed, serialised with object keys sorted, no whitespace and UTF-8. Not the file's bytes: the lab reads fixtures through a transport that re-serialises JSON.
